correctness.rationale: Exact branch-and-bound searches compatibility graphs from all graph edges, using proper coloring for certified clique upper bounds and strict pruning to preserve all optimal ties; it establishes the full n=1..8 sequence and exactly twelve maximizers at n=8. Independent MILP solves the same n=1..8 values with optimum status. Distance and singleton-neighbor structural argument proves automorphism group order two, and all optima are reversal-paired.

value.rationale: Strong matchings represent mutually noninterfering communication links, a natural and strictly stronger analogue of the disjoint edge packings previously studied in Fibonacci cubes. The exact first observed Fibonacci-pattern breakdown together with all maximizers and six symmetry orbits constitutes a useful reproducible boundary benchmark for future structural recurrence and packing investigations, not a routine restatement of vertex-disjoint matching counts.
